catalog.name: Hushle
catalog.summary: Taboo-style word guessing built for live voice rooms.
hushle.between.deckEmptyWaiting: No cards are left. The host will end the game.
hushle.between.hostHint: Start the next turn when everyone is ready.
hushle.between.waiting: Waiting for the host to start the next turn…
hushle.board.floaterHint: The floater takes turns explaining for both teams.
hushle.card.label: Word card
hushle.ended.tieBody: {teams} share the win with {count, plural, one {# point} other {# points}}.
hushle.ended.title: Game over
hushle.ended.waiting: The host can start a new game.
hushle.ended.winnerScore: Final score: {count, plural, one {# point} other {# points}}
hushle.header.cardsLeft: {count, plural, one {# card left} other {# cards left}}
hushle.header.cardsPlayed: {count, plural, one {# card played} other {# cards played}}
hushle.hidden.deckEmptyHost: End the game to see the final scores.
hushle.hidden.guesserBody: The card is hidden from your team. Shout your guesses in voice.
hushle.hidden.pickExplainer: Pick an explainer in the host tools.
hushle.hidden.watcherBody: Only the explainer and the other team can see the card.
hushle.host.explainerHint: Hand the turn to someone else — for example, if a player left.
hushle.host.nextCardHint: Swaps the card without scoring it.
hushle.howTo.bust: The other team sees the card too. If a forbidden word slips out, they press Bust.
hushle.howTo.explain: The explainer describes the word on the card without saying any of the forbidden words under it — as many cards as they can before the turn's time runs out.
hushle.howTo.score: The host scores every card: a guess earns a point, a skip earns nothing, a bust costs a point.
hushle.howTo.teams: Split into two teams. Teams take turns, and each turn the next player in the team explains while their teammates guess.
hushle.howTo.title: How to play
hushle.lobby.hostPrompt: Start a new Hushle game for this voice room.
hushle.lobby.teamSizeHint: Two teams of two is the classic game. With an odd number of players, one is the floater and explains for both teams.
hushle.lobby.turnDurationHint: For the whole turn: as many cards as the team can get before it runs out.
hushle.lobby.waitingBody: The host picks the word pack and the settings. Teams come next.
hushle.lobby.waitingForHost: Waiting for the host to start the game…
hushle.playing.explainerHint: Describe the word without saying any of the forbidden words. The host scores each card.
hushle.playing.opponentHint: Watch the explainer — if they say a forbidden word, press BUST.
hushle.playing.secondsLeft: {count, plural, one {# second left} other {# seconds left}}
hushle.playing.youAreOpponent: You're on the other team — watch for forbidden words
hushle.roles.guessersBody: The card stays hidden. They listen to {name} and shout their guesses in voice.
hushle.roles.title: Who sees the card
hushle.roles.watchersBody: If {name} says a forbidden word, they press Bust.
hushle.roles.watchersTitle: {teams} {count, plural, one {watches the card} other {watch the card}}
hushle.tagline: Taboo-style word guessing for voice rooms
hushle.teamSetup.benchEmpty: Everyone in the room is on a team.
hushle.teamSetup.hostPrompt: Add at least two teams, then start the first turn.
hushle.teamSetup.noTeamsHint: Split the room into two teams, or add a team and seat people one by one.
hushle.teamSetup.seats: {count} of {max, plural, one {# player} other {# players}}
